from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageChops
root=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry')
src=root/'pizza_screen_minus01_rotated_cw0p5_cross_bisectors_10px.png'
dst=root/'pizza_screen_minus01_rotated_cw0p5_cross_bisectors_vertical_plus20px.png'
with Image.open(src) as im:
    base=im.convert('RGB')
assert base.size==(1448,1448),base.size
out=base.copy()
draw=ImageDraw.Draw(out)
start_x=719
line_width=10
step=20
offsets=[]
for offset in range(step,1448-start_x,step):
    left=start_x+offset
    right=min(1447,left+line_width-1)
    draw.rectangle((left,0,right,1447),fill=(0,0,0))
    offsets.append((offset,left,right))
assert len(offsets)==36,len(offsets)
assert offsets[0]==(20,739,748),offsets[0]
assert offsets[-1]==(720,1439,1447),offsets[-1]
assert out.size==(1448,1448)
assert ImageChops.difference(out.crop((0,0,739,1448)),base.crop((0,0,739,1448))).getbbox() is None, 'left of first new line changed'
assert ImageChops.difference(out.crop((0,719,1448,729)),base.crop((0,719,1448,729))).getbbox() is None, 'horizontal bisector changed'
for n,(offset,left,right) in enumerate(offsets):
    for y in (0,718,723,729,1447):
        assert all(out.getpixel((x,y))==(0,0,0) for x in range(left,right+1)),(offset,y)
    if n:
        prior_right=offsets[n-1][2]
        assert ImageChops.difference(out.crop((prior_right+1,0,left,1448)),base.crop((prior_right+1,0,left,1448))).getbbox() is None, 'inter-line gap changed'
out.save(dst,format='PNG',compress_level=6)
print('SOURCE',src,'DIMENSIONS',base.size,flush=True)
print('LINE_CONFIGURATION','black','10px','step_20px','positive-x only',flush=True)
print('CENTRAL_BISECTOR_COLUMNS','719..728','ADDITIONAL_LINE_COUNT',len(offsets),'FIRST',offsets[0],'LAST',offsets[-1],flush=True)
print('OUTPUT',dst,'DIMENSIONS',out.size,'BYTES',dst.stat().st_size,'SHA256',sha256(dst.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
PY

  gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$DST" --jq '[.path,.size,.sha] | @tsv'
  printf 'LOCAL_BLOB ';git hash-object "$DST"
  exit 0
 fi
done
